interpretation: Generator reading, a strengthening of the -A disjunction: the natural motion of the light and the heavy has a per se mover, what generated them. Ground: VIII.4 says fire and earth are moved by something also when they move by nature to their own actualities (255a28-30), and calls the remover a mover only per accidens (255b24-27); of the two movers 256a1-2 names, only the generator is left as a per se mover. The text does not say that the generator still moves the light thing while it rises; that is this reading's open commitment, and -A does not make it.
